cover letter
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training. (Required)

In this position, the Health Education Coordinator will design, conduct, promote, evaluate and support the experiential education of preclinical medical students in community and clinical sites in compliance with organizational objectives and nationally accepted accreditation standards and requirements.
Clinical Skills Session Logistics Coordination - 25%
Coordinates and supports logistical implementation of clinical skills sessions when standardized patients are present, ensuring sessions run smoothly and on time.
Program Files and Data Maintenance - 15%
Maintains updated program files and data in Google Drive and bCourses, which may include course session documents, individual learner files, and clinical skills content and administrative resources.
Learner Progress Reporting - 5%
Generates regular reports of individual and aggregate learner progress and assessment.
Standardized Patient, Student and Instructor Support - 10%
Acts as a point person for standardized patient, student, and instructor questions regarding clinical skills sessions.
Clinical Skills Team Meeting Support - 5%
Supports clinical skills team meetings, including note taking and providing updates on the standardized patient program, class session logistics, assignment tracking, and onboarding tracking.
Program Implementation Systems Support - 10%
Provides recommendations and assistance in creating systems to support smooth program implementation, including email templates, timelines, assessment documentation tools.
Community Building and Educational Activity Logistics - 10%
Assists with logistics and coordination for community building events and / or educational activities, which may include community partner recruitment and assessment activities.
Standardized Patient Program Management - 20%
Manages the standardized patient program, including recruitment, training, and in person support during sessions.
Working knowledge of common organization- or research-specific and other computer application programs.
Proficient in communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Proficient in ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
Demonstrates ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
Demonstrates ability to analyze, research and synthesize large amounts of data with strong attention to detail.
Proficient in ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.
Working knowledge of applicable policy analysis techniques.

pay.source_text: ience. The budgeted hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position is $31.68 - $33.00. This is a non-exempt, bi-weekly paid position. This is a 1-year, part-time (16 hours/week) Limited
